## B. Architecture + inference code (most important)

PROD SmallCNN verbatim (`D:/PotatoBackend/small_cnn.py`):

```python
import torch.nn as nn
class SmallCNN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, n=3, drop=0.4):
        super().__init__()
        def block(cin, cout):
            return nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(cin, cout, 3, padding=1, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(cout), nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
                nn.Conv2d(cout, cout, 3, padding=1, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(cout), nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
                nn.MaxPool2d(2), nn.Dropout2d(0.1))
        self.f = nn.Sequential(block(3, 32), block(32, 64), block(64, 128),
                               block(128, 256), nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1))
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(nn.Flatten(), nn.Dropout(drop),
            nn.Linear(256, 128), nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.Dropout(drop), nn.Linear(128, n))
    def forward(self, x): return self.fc(self.f(x))
```

Loader verbatim (`D:/PotatoBackend/app.py:75-96`):

```python
def build_arch(mid, n):
    if mid == "small_cnn":
        from small_cnn import SmallCNN
        return SmallCNN(n)                       # n=4 from ckpt; drop default 0.4
    if mid == "mobilenetv2":
        m = models.mobilenet_v2(); m.classifier[1] = nn.Linear(m.last_channel, n); return m
    if mid == "efficientnetb0":
        m = models.efficientnet_b0(); m.classifier[1] = nn.Linear(m.classifier[1].in_features, n); return m
ckpt = torch.load(ckpt_p, map_location=device, weights_only=False)
m = build_arch(mid, n).to(device); m.load_state_dict(ckpt["state"]); m.eval()
```

(torchvision `torch>=2.2, torchvision>=0.17`, stock arch + replaced head only.)

Numpy forward (small_cnn, eval mode â€” Dropout/Droput2d = identity):
`y=conv(x)`: cross-correlation, stride 1, pad 1, weights `(Cout,Cin,3,3)`, NO bias.
`BN(y) = w*(y-mean)/sqrt(var+eps)+b` with saved weight/bias/running_mean/running_var,
`eps=1e-5` (PyTorch default â€” critical). `ReLU=max(0,Â·)`. `MaxPool2d(2)` = 2x2 stride 2.
`AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)` = global spatial mean â†’ 256-vector. `Flatten` row-major.
`Linear`: `y=x@W.T+b`. Final output = 4 raw logits (NO softmax inside).



## C. Preprocessing, ensemble, class order, gate (verbatim)

```python
# D:/PotatoBackend/app.py:99-113 â€” preprocessing + per-model softmax
MEAN = [0.485, 0.456, 0.406]; STD = [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]
def tfm_for(img, transfer):
    norm = transforms.Normalize(MEAN, STD) if transfer else transforms.Normalize([0.5]*3, [0.5]*3)
    return transforms.Compose([transforms.Resize(int(img*1.14)), transforms.CenterCrop(img),
                               transforms.ToTensor(), norm])
# transfer=True for mobilenetv2/efficientnetb0 (ImageNet stats), False for small_cnn ([0.5]).
# img=224 from every ckpt -> Resize(255) BILINEAR, CenterCrop(224). ToTensor: RGB uint8 -> float /255, HWC->CHW.
# PIL does Image.open(bytes).convert("RGB"); JPEG/PNG/WebP only, 10 MB cap.
def probs_of(mid, img):
    ...
    return torch.softmax(m(x), 1).cpu().numpy()[0], img, api
```

```python
# ensemble = MEAN OF MEMBER SOFTMAX (not logits) â€” D:/PotatoBackend/app.py:211-224
ps = [probs_of(m, img) for m in ["small_cnn","mobilenetv2","efficientnetb0"]]
p = np.mean(ps, axis=0)
pred_label = api[int(p.argmax())]   # api = ["Early Blight","Late Blight","Healthy","Non-Leaf"]
# csv->api: {"early_blight":"Early Blight","late_blight":"Late Blight","healthy":"Healthy","non_leaf":"Non-Leaf"}
```

```python
# gate â€” D:/PotatoBackend/app.py:122-132, 225-236 (Non-Leaf checked FIRST)
def norm_entropy(p):
    p = np.clip(p, 1e-9, 1); h = float(-(p*np.log(p)).sum()); return h / math.log(len(p))
ENT_MAX, PROB_MIN = 0.85, 0.55   # from calibration/thresholds.json (PROD file, Â§F)
if pred_label == "Non-Leaf":
    return Unknown(conf=mx, entropy=ent, probabilities={}, ...)   # retake message
if ent > ENT_MAX or mx < PROB_MIN:
    return Unknown(conf=mx, entropy=ent, probabilities={}, ...)   # retake message
out = {"class": pred_label, "confidence": mx, "is_unknown": False,
       "entropy": ent, "green_ratio": round(g, 3),
       "probabilities": {c: float(v) for c, v in zip(api, p)}}
```

```python
# green_ratio â€” D:/PotatoBackend/app.py:115-120 (logged, NEVER a hard reject)
a = np.asarray(img.resize((112, 112)).convert("RGB")).astype(int)
R, G, B = a[..., 0], a[..., 1], a[..., 2]
g = float(((G > R + 15) & (G > B + 15) & (G > 60)).mean())
```

## E. Training info

PROD family (`outputs_combined`, config `time 2026-09-27`): epochs 25, batch 32,
img 224, seed 42, `train_csv=combined_train.csv`, optimizer **AdamW lr=1e-3 (m1 rate;
transfer members same script default), weight_decay=1e-4**, scheduler
ReduceLROnPlateau(patience 3, factor 0.3), loss **class-weighted CE + label smoothing
0.1**, WeightedRandomSampler, early-stop patience 7 (`best.pt` = val-F1 peak),
drop 0.4. Augmentation (train): RandomResizedCrop(224, scale 0.7â€“1.0),
RandomHorizontalFlip 0.5, RandomRotation 30, ColorJitter(0.4,0.4,0.4,0.1),
GaussianBlur(5, sigma 0.1â€“2.0), RandomAdjustSharpness(2, p 0.25),
RandomAutocontrast(p 0.2), ToTensor+norm, RandomErasing(p 0.35, scale 0.02â€“0.2).
Eval tfm = Â§C (no augmentation). Trainer: `train_image.py` (root of D:/Potato).

Robust family: same script, batch 64, `train_csv=robust_train.csv`, loss ce,
oversample false, `time 2026-10-02`.

Class distribution (train):

| split | early | late | healthy | non_leaf | total |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| combined_train (PROD) | 3301 | 3267 | 2530 | 960 | 10058 |
| robust_train | 3301 | 3569 | 2970 | 2239 | 12079 |

non_leaf composition â€” the OOD-miss story: PROD non_leaf (960) = **100% COCO persons**
(`non_leaf/coco_person/`, COCO val2017 person-not-potted-plant). No soil, no hands, no
tools, no other crops. Robust non_leaf (2239) = 861 coco_person + 1006 field `_staging`
(BARI/Central-Java/Ethiopia/OpenImages/PlantDoc/WE3DS) + 372 non_leaf_v2. Hence PROD is
blind to soil (50.6% reject) and leaves (84.1%), perfect on persons/phones (100%).

Reported test performance: PROD ensemble 100% on PlantVillage test (276/276); robust
ensemble 95.29% on external locked test (446), 100% PV regression, 98.65% Irish grouped
(source: `release_robust_v1/README.txt`, `outputs_combined/metrics.json`:
ensemble acc 1.0 / f1-macro 1.0).
